rows.notes: The cited document is a systematic literature review (SLR) of 214 articles on UAV imagery in agriculture (Section 3, Methodology; Fig. 1). It reports no own field data, experiment, survey or model runs; its 'results' are counts and taxonomies of reviewed papers (e.g., 24/119 CVPR papers on crop disease detection, Section 4.5.2). Any statements about tracking crop health, yield prediction or disease/pest detection are summaries of other studies, so Q1 is 'no' and all subsequent questions are 'no'. Note also that the review mainly documents detection/classification of diseases and pests, not mitigation or control, so even as a review it would be upstream of the claimed pest-control effect.
